name: manual_ad5801
claim: When a review-fix PR has drifted behind current main, reconcile main first and resolve conflicts by synthesis, then apply reviewer comments; do not stack fixes on a stale branch.

decisions.notes: PR #241 required merging current PT main, preserving main's newer restore behavior and memory/lockfile changes, then applying the ECC overlay hardening fixes in one cohesive follow-up commit.
